Subject: Final runbook: greenlight decision, signature routing, and start-date confirmation

Hi Olivia / Nathan —

Thanks again for a productive evaluation week. Attached is the final MAP (MAP_v5.xlsx) and the SOW with the redlines we discussed (SOW_draft_redlines.pdf). This thread is to lock the final go/no-go and establish a clear signer + start-date plan so procurement/legal at Stargrove can receive a single DocuSign packet.

Quick recap / asks:
- MAP: Scope, acceptance criteria, and 2-week pilot schedule are in tab "EvalPlan".
- Signers: who at Stargrove will sign (name/email + title)? We need a primary and one alternate for time-zone redundancy.
- Start date: suggested start = 2027-09-20 (Monday) — can you confirm? If you need a later date, please indicate the earliest acceptable date.
- Procurement items outstanding: SOC 2 report (we can provide a link or package), and updated PO template if you use one.

If I don't hear objections to the redlines by EOD Friday (2027-09-03), we'll prepare the DocuSign envelope and route to your signer list for an expected 48-hour e-sign window.

Attachments: MAP_v5.xlsx (mutual action plan), SOW_draft_redlines.pdf (legal redlines)

Thanks — would like to lock timing so engineering and onboarding can schedule the day-one checklist.

—Markus

Thanks Markus — appreciate the clear packet. Quick answers from Stargrove:

- Signer: Nathan Lee (CPO) will be primary signer; alternate is Olivia Grant (Head of Data Partnerships). Nathan's email: nathan.lee@starlight.co (same as on thread).
- Start date: 2027-09-20 is fine for product onboarding, but procurement asked whether we can push operational start to 2027-09-27 to give legal time to finish a short PO review. Is that acceptable to Redwood?
- SOC 2: could you attach a cached SOC 2 brief or provide a link to the audit package? That will unblock legal.

Also saw one redline in the SOW re: data retention that our legal flagged — they attached an internal note which I'll forward if needed. For now we want to move forward; please prepare DocuSign with the two signers and include a copy to our procurement mailbox procurement@stargrove.ai.

Thanks,
Olivia

Markus / Kimberly —

Legal has reviewed the SOW redlines and provided two small edits that are non-material from a commercial perspective:
1) Narrowed the data retention clause to 90 days for ephemeral inference logs (we kept customer-owned persistent telemetry at customer-specified retention).
2) Minor indemnity language clarifying third-party claims procedure.

I'll attach the redline PDF we plan to send to Stargrove as 'SOW_final_redline_for_ds.pdf' in the DocuSign packet. Procurement asked for SOC 2 evidence — we should send the SOC 2 attest report link and a one-pager summary. Kimberly, can you pull the SOC 2 public package and share?

Assuming no showstopper, I recommend:
- Route DocuSign on Monday 2027-09-06 to Nathan (primary) and Olivia (alternate), cc procurement@stargrove.ai.
- Set the signature reminder cadence to 48 hours.
- Target operational start = 2027-09-27 (per Stargrove procurement).

We should also include the onboarding kick-off call in the DocuSign email notes so they have the week-of dates for the project lead.

—Marissa
